You find the license plate and the car attached to it without
too much trouble. The car is a black 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle.
From the look of things, the car has been sitting for a while to
judge by the thick layer of dust that covers it. A valet notices
you looking at the car and approaches.
'This car has been here for years," the valet explains. "I don't
think it even runs now. The old owner of the hotel didn't care
that it was here. He didn't care about most things which is
why he lost the hotel and someone else was able to buy it for a
steal. The new owner, however, is set on fixing this place up.
So, I would expect that this car will be towed to the junkyard
or sold at some point in the very near future. If you want to
check the car out, be my guest. It's nothing to me. The key is
under the visor."
There isn't much of note inside the car. But, when you look in
the trunk, you discover an old turntable and a single vinyl
record.
I. SUMMER ONE DAY
2. SO. ME AND YOU...
3. THINKING
4. KING GREED
The evil presence in 1313 that Fargo and Katie
summoned knows that you are about to cleanse the
hotel and is none too happy about it. Items are hurled
across the room. Unseen hands push you and scratch
you. Your name is whispered with malevolent intent.
But, you stay focused. Using all of the items and steps
mentioned in Fargo's notes, you follow the instructions
perfectly, and when you are done, the room and the
entire building feels immediately lighter. It feels free.
As if on cue, two shadow people emerge from room
1305. At first the two figures are distinct and separate.
Then, inexplicably, the two meld into one shadow
figure. The sight confuses you at first until you
remember that Fargo and Katie were in love. And just
as two people symbolically become one when they get
married, Fargo and Katie have literally done their
version of that in front of your very eyes.
"Thank you," they whisper before exploding in a puff
of smoke and disappearing before your very eyes. The
sight might be touching if it wasn't so strange.
As far as you are concerned, their troubled souls have
moved on to the next life and the demonic presence
they summoned has been vanquished. The 13th floor is
now cleansed.
You head to the manager's office to give him the good
news and wonder if you should bill the hotel extra for
doing battle with the forces of evil. It certainly seems
like it would be worth an extra 10%. Onto the next
haunting.
Case closed.
You get a bad feeling the moment you set foot in room
1313. There is a heaviness in the air and you sense an evil
presence. The spirits of Fargo and Katie told you that they
summoned something in 1313. After spending several
minutes in the room, you notice a piece of sheetrock has
been replaced on one section of the wall. You use a
pocketknife to dig at the seam enough to allow you to get
your fingers behind it and pull the sheetrock away from the
stud. You see the mummified remains of a woman behind
the wall. She is holding a note. It reads:
"We were madly in love. But, the cult wasn't going to let he
r go. Baron wasn't going to let her go. In all my years of pl
aying with Zombified Zeus, I had heard stories about peopl
e dabbling in the occult and dealing in the black arts. I sug

ion book. It seems like an idiotic idea now. At the time, i
t was genius. Something like that couldn't land either of u
s in jail. The courts don't recognize the supernatura
1. So, if our plan worked, she could be free of the cult. I
f not, we were free to try something else. As it turned out,
our plan worked too well. We summoned something.
That something-an evil spirit, a demon, whatever yo
u want to call it-possessed Baron Vance and drove him t
o kill the other members of the group and himself. He
would have killed Katie too if I hadn't saved her. But,
once Baron was dead, whatever was inside him, found Katie
and took control of her, forcing her to attack me. She tri
ed to kill me, and ultimately, I stabbed her while defending m
yself. I know it wasn't her though. But, it broke my he
art. Every bit of this was my fault. I put her in this wall,
hoping that what we had unleashed would never see the lig
ht of day again. But, eventually, the evil came for me, and
it's inside me now. I'm barely in control of myself. I can
feel it getting stronger. I'm writing this letter before I head
back to my room where a bowl of pills awaits me.
Hopefully, this ends the tragedy, and I can be with my
Katie again. I want to spend my eternity with her. One
more thing though. I used a ouija board to ask whoever or
whatever was out there listening how to get rid of this
unclean spirit, and they told me to do the following: light
some candles, burn some sage, recite a very specific passage
from a certain prayer book, draw some sigils on the wall,
cut my palm with a knife and let the blood drip down, and
then ring a bell. If thepresence is still roaming the
thirteenth floor, I would try this as a means of getting rid
of it. I would do it myself, but I can't since it lives inside of
me now. It won't allow it. I'm not even sure if it will allow
me to take my own life. We will see."
